description:
The platform comparison matrix (docs/platforms/comparison-matrix.md) is severely
incomplete and structurally inadequate. Currently documents only 8 of 28 SQL platforms
(28% coverage) and 4 of 7 DataFrame platforms (57% coverage).

Key problems identified in documentation review:
- 20 SQL platforms missing from all comparison tables
- 3 DataFrame platforms missing (Modin, Dask, cuDF)
- Azure platforms incorrectly marked as "planned" when fully implemented
- Tables with 8+ columns are unreadable on most screens
- No categorical grouping makes navigation difficult
- Decision framework doesn't include most available options

Proposed solution: Restructure into grouped comparison tables by category,
reducing column count per table while achieving 100% platform coverage.
